Trap Runes
24% of base mana
1 sec cast3 sec cooldown
Etch a Trap Rune onto a surface for up to 5 min.

Learning this spell teaches you 3 Trap Glyphs you can carve onto the Trap Runes which determine what happens when an enemy activates them.

You cannot place multiple Trap Runes within 10 yds of eachother.
Traprune: Blasting Glyph
Apply the Blasting Glyph effect to a Traprune, causing it to blast the enemy that triggers it, dealing Arcane Damage and knocking them away from it.

Traprune: Stunning Glyph
Apply the Stunning Glyph effect to a Traprune, causing it to stun the enemy that triggers it for 4 sec.

Traprune: Unmaking Glyph
Apply the Unmaking Glyph effect to a Traprune, applying a damage over time effect to the enemy that triggers it and increase the critical strike chance of spells cast against them by 8% for 12 sec.
